title: Senior Sales Executive (m/w/d)
description:
Senior Sales Executive

EU GTM | Berlin, Germany

About the team 🙌

SumUp's Sales team in Germany is on a roll — and we need a Key Account Executive in Berlin who's built different. This role is for someone who thrives in the hunt: picking up the phone, opening doors, and creating pipeline out of nothing. Once you've won the merchant, you'll own the relationship too — growing the account and making sure they're getting the most out of SumUp. The AM side? You'll pick it up. The hunter mindset? That needs to already be in you. If cold outreach energises you and closing deals is what gets you out of bed — keep reading. 👇

What you'll do

  • 🤝 Own and grow a portfolio of SMB accounts — be their go-to person and make sure they're getting the most out of SumUp

  • 💡 Spot upsell and cross-sell opportunities and act on them — match merchants with the right products at the right time

  • 🎯 Go after new business through outbound calls, emails, and local networking — you're not waiting for leads to come to you

  • 🗣️ Lead consultative conversations that put the merchant's needs first before pitching anything

  • 📊 Own your full sales cycle from first touch to close, with clean CRM records throughout

  • 🏆 Hit monthly targets across both new business and account growth — consistently

  • 🤜 Work closely with onboarding, customer success, and product teams to make sure merchants succeed long-term

You'll be great for this role if…

  • You've got experience in account management, sales, or a customer-facing B2B role — SMB experience is a big plus

  • You're just as comfortable hunting for new business as you are nurturing existing accounts — you see both as wins

title: Customer & Development Operations
description:
You'll stay close to our customer base, spot which projects are moving toward deployment, and make sure Furo is there when they do: turning our planning platform into a gateway for the next stage of our product. You'll work directly with the founders and help build a new function from the ground up.
 You'll Have Fun If You Are Founder at Heart
 You get energy from building something that doesn't exist yet — no templates, no playbook
 You thrive wearing multiple hats across sales, customer success, product, and business development
 Commercially Sharp
 You genuinely love talking to customers and are curious about their world
 People want to say yes to you — whether you're building trust or closing the next step
 Data-Driven and Structured
 You're as comfortable in data (e.g., Supabase or Hubspot) as you are on a customer call
 You don't just track things, you build systems: scalable processes, automated workflows, dashboards that tell you what to do next
 You believe that the best commercial instinct is backed by data
 You Won't Have Fun If You Are scared of hardware: You’ll build a solid understanding of the energy system on site and stay on top of our integration landscape to get our battery projects running
 Can't spend half your day talking to customers: this role lives and dies on relationships
 Feel uncomfortable digging into databases, user stats, or platform analytics
 Expect top-down instructions: we trust you to figure it out
 Prefer a typical 9–5: we move fast and take full ownership
 Don't enjoy being close to customers and partners — we visit sites across Germany
 Qualifications Fast-paced environment in your past: top-tier consulting, a hypergrowth startup, or a commercial role in energy or infrastructure
 Experience in operations-focused roles and managing a large customer portfolio with structured processes
 C1 German or higher — most of our customers are German-speaking

title: HR Generalist - EMEA
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co .
 We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions
 About the role We are looking for an HR Generalist to join our People team and support our growing EMEA organization. This is an early-career role built for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and eager to learn how a world-class People function operates at one of the fastest-growing technology companies in the world.
You will be a key point of contact for employees across the region—owning the day-to-day administration of benefits, employment documents, and contracts, while also helping to build the kind of culture and community that makes Applied Intuition a place people are proud to work. title: Praktikant Online Marketing & Content (w/m/d)
description:
Die Spread Group ist ein international agierendes Lifestyle- und Fashion-Tech-Unternehmen. Wir setzen auf einfach individualisierbare Produkte, die exakt den Vorstellungen unserer Kund*innen entsprechen. Als Vorreiter im Bereich der Made-to-Order Technologien verbinden wir Nachhaltigkeit mit passgenauen Lösungen. Ob für Privatpersonen oder Unternehmen – bei uns bekommt Fashion ihren individuellen Ausdruck. Wir machen die Einzigartigkeit jedes Menschen mit individueller Fashion sichtbar.
 Wir sind auf dem Weg, die Fashion-Branche ressourcenschonend neu zu gestalten, mit innovativen Denkansätzen und digitalen Lösungen für die herausfordernden Fragen unserer Zeit.
 Dafür suchen wir engagierte Talente wie dich: Bereichere als Praktikant*in Online Marketing & Content (w/m/d) unser dynamisches Team und lass uns gemeinsam innovative Lösungen entwickeln.
 Es handelt sich um eine Vollzeitposition im Rahmen eines Pflichtpraktikums oder freiwilligen Praktikums und bietet die Flexibilität in unserem Leipziger Headquarter zu arbeiten.
 Über die Rolle
 Unser External Marketplaces Team ist für die Präsentation und Vermarktung des stetig wachsenden Angebots an Produkten und Designs auf den bedeutendsten Online-Marktplätzen, wie Amazon und eBay, verantwortlich. Zur Unterstützung im Bereich Online Marketing suchen wir dich ab sofort für 3-6 Monate.
 Was dich bei uns erwartet
 Du unterstützt uns bei der Erweiterung und Optimierung unserer Angebote aus den Bereichen Licensing, Marketplace und Personalisierung
 Du kümmerst dich um die Bearbeitung personalisierter Bestellungen von Amazon
 Du erstellst kreative Inhalte für unsere Amazon Brand Stores, die Kund*innen begeistern und unsere Marke stärken
 Du recherchierst zu aktuellen Themen und Trends aus den Bereichen Licensing und Bekleidung
 Du arbeitest gemeinsam mit dem Team an der Umsetzung neuer Projekte

title: (Senior) Campaign Manager (f/m/d)
description:
Who We Are Spread Group is a renowned global provider of customized apparel and lifestyle products, distinguished by our commitment to made-to-order technology. Our core business model revolves around producing precisely what our customers desire, precisely when they desire it. As pioneers in this space, we combine sustainability with on-demand personalization, enabling individuals and businesses to express their unique identities through bespoke creations. Join us to be part of a global leader in the exciting world of personalized apparel and lifestyle products!
 As we continue to expand our business, we are seeking a curious and passionate individual to join our team as the (Senior) Campaign Manager (f/m/d) and drive our business forward.
 What Will Your Role Be We're looking for a Senior Campaign Manager to own marketing campaign planning and execution across our entire D2C business. You'll be the person who spots the right seasonal moments, turns them into compelling campaign concepts, and rallies our paid, CRM, SEO, and creative teams to bring them to life - on time and on target. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role with direct exposure to senior leadership.
 What You´ll Do Own the Campaign Calendar
 Identify seasonal events, cultural moments, and product opportunities worth building campaigns around
 Maintain a forward-looking campaign roadmap 8–12 weeks ahead, balancing MP-specific, CYO-specific, and D2C-wide initiatives
 Plan Campaigns End-to-End
 Write clear campaign briefs covering objectives, audience, channels, messaging, KPIs, and timelines
 Define the channel mix and coordinate with Paid Marketing, Paid Social, CRM, On-Page, and SEO teams to align on execution
 Drive Production
 Brief creative teams on asset needs - graphics, copy, landing pages, email templates - and manage the approval process
 Initiate and oversee campaign-related photo shoots from concept to delivery
 Deliver and Measure
